rationale: Both forms can denote shallot in Malaysian Malay, so the proposed Indonesian-versus-Malaysian contrast and different-common-word relation are misleading. “Bawang kecil” is a valid Malaysian term, but “bawang merah” is also established Malaysian usage; the card needs a shared-synonym or preference-qualified contrast.
